name: DarkBERT-benchmark
description: DarkBERT-benchmark evaluates models on classification and detection tasks over text harvested from dark-web and underground forums. It measures the ability to identify illicit, harmful, or otherwise domain-specific content under noisy, adversarial, and jargon-heavy language. The benchmark is intended to test robustness and content-sensitivity of language models in safety-relevant settings.
reputation: Niche dataset with limited but growing use in research on dark-web content detection and safety-focused models.
